quote: Rest is not laziness; it is restoration
explanation: A culture that glorifies overwork and exhaustion is one that misunderstands human nature rest is the foundation on which creativity, resilience, and connection are built.
long_explanation:
True community resilience starts with good health, balanced nutrition, and clean surroundings that allow families to thrive.

How this connects with our mission:
At Jalte Diye Foundation, our healthcare initiatives focus on preventive health awareness, clean drinking water, and balanced community nutrition.

Take Action:
Drink an extra glass of water and add a serving of fresh fruits or vegetables to your meals today.
